verdict: M1351 rejects 21 of 22 fresh attacks and retains all 39 predecessor/author tests, but a leaf symlink used as the config path is accepted because secure_no_symlink_ancestry resolves the candidate before inspecting path components. The zero-false-negative admission gate therefore fails.

fresh_hammer.accepted_attack_effect: A read-only symlink leaf inside the workspace points to the genuine config file; build accepts it and returns a source-fixture result.
fresh_hammer.root_cause: candidate.resolve() removes the symlink leaf before the ancestry loop, so the loop inspects only the resolved real path.
fresh_hammer.minimum_successor: Inspect every lexical candidate component with lstat before resolution, including the leaf, then separately prove resolved containment. Add a leaf-symlink regression and receive a new different-author hammer.

correctly_rejected_classes: nonhex, empty, replaced and mismatched address trace
all-zero DRAM, all-zero SRAM and one-zero-macro planes
address cycles unequal to conserved charge
stall partition mismatch and stall bound violation
